item.title: Cailar & Calra
item.description:
Product Overview

In Taiwan, there is a growing emphasis on art education, yet a significant gap in students’ understanding and exploration of color concepts. Cailar & Carla aimed to bridge this gap by creating an interactive learning product to introduce elementary students to the fundamentals of color theory.

Cailar & Carla is an interactive color learning product designed for elementary students (ages 7–11) to explore color theory through hands-on play. By integrating a plush tactile controller and an accompanying physical picture book with a gamified mobile app, children can capture colors from their real-world environment to solve challenges. This multimodal approach addresses the lack of engaging, depth-oriented color education in current curriculums.
